ranking_note: Authored from the before descriptions at commit 871a753a97a3d9db8dcfbcc217aad49495a3fd08, frozen before the rewrite; protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. Competitors are map-events (who publishes which message, the hand-off target) and map-components and map-dependencies (static structure rather than a runtime path from one entry point). map-flow traces one C# entry point into a cited sequence diagram.
